rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) sustained a bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises (walkway) due to an icy condition, triggering premises liability coverage.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor slipped on ice on policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm and broke her wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Pediatric injury with ongoing treatment; requires prompt investigation and coverage verification.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway during ice storm
